repo.description: VCS repository slug (owner/name on GitHub, group/project on GitLab). OIDC trust conditions bind CI identities to exactly this repository.

environments.description: Fixed at launch; present for forward compatibility.

manifest_ref.description: Pinned reference to an environment manifest published by a platform repo (Path F consumers).

containers.description: Per-environment isolation container ids: GCP project ids or Azure subscription ids (required for those clouds); AWS accounts are implied by the federated credentials.

monthly_budget_alert.description: Total monthly budget across environments. When set, each environment gets a real cloud budget (AWS Budgets / GCP billing budget / Azure consumption budget) for its even share. Budgets notify; they do not cap.

alert_emails.description: Recipients of budget notifications. Required when monthly_budget_alert is set.

billing_account.description: GCP only: the billing account id (XXXXXX-XXXXXX-XXXXXX) budgets are created on. Required on GCP when monthly_budget_alert is set.

monthly_ceiling.description: The hard limit, enforced where a limit can actually be enforced: before anything exists. estimate exits nonzero and scaffold refuses when the expected total exceeds it.

usage.description: Explicit usage assumptions overriding tier defaults. A tier name is not a usage estimate; these numbers are.

overrides.description: module -> input -> value. Only inputs allowlisted by the catalog may be overridden; all overrides are schema- and policy-checked.

name.description: lowercase alphanumeric + hyphen; used in {org}-{app}-{env}-{component} resource names
